author: Dexerto
text:
Burger King’s Attack on Titan collab is reportedly returning with a black Founding Titan Whopper, but it’s only available in Russia

The menu reportedly includes red cheese, “Titan Injection” sauce, “Rumbling” sriracha seasoning, and a cameo from fan-favorite character Gabi
